name: ARA-EXP-BRG-005
title: Bridge protocol version mismatch
summary: An authenticated request has a version other than 1. The server returns a diagnostic without executing the command.
html:
An authenticated request has a version other than 1. The server returns a diagnostic without executing the command.

#Common causes

  • The client uses a different wire protocol version.

#Fixes

  • Send version: 1 and use matching ara-bridge request types.

  • Code: ARA-EXP-BRG-005 (slot 8084)

  • Constant: bridge::BRG_005

  • Reported by: ara-bridge
